At 22876
[Intro Date:

ORDINANCE Septem ber 2 5 n 2015

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the DX-3, Downtown Mixed-Use District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 4-E in the area bounded by:

a line 84.89 feet south of and parallel to East 18" Street; the alley east of and parallel to
South Prairie Ave.; a line 131 feet south of and parallel to East 18" Street; and South
Prairie Ave.

to those of a DR-3, Downtown Residential District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 1811 South Prairie Ave.
